reuse.why: Routes the flag through the shared assertBankAccountNotLinked used by every provider, but copies unlinkAccount's local field-clearing instead of pulling it into a helper both can call.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block that clears account_id, bank, balances, sync source and sync status is copied word for word from unlinkAccount, so the definition of an unlinked account now lives in two places.

placement.why: Threading the flag through the one shared pre-link check is the right layer, but a function named assert...NotLinked now mutates another account, and does so before the new link is written.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the flag, its plumbing through the six provider link functions and tests; the only unrelated edit is a blank import line in the test.

maintainability.why: Readable and consistent across providers, but the misnamed side-effecting assert and the copied unlink field list will drift if unlinking ever clears more fields.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts clears the old account with its own db.updateAccount instead of reusing unlinkAccount's local-clear step (the comment says it avoids the provider cleanup, but no local-only part is extracted).

disguised_duplication.where: The copied db.updateAccount field list is a verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's, not disguised.
